'''February 2001 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Granite City, St. Cloud, MN on 24 February 2001. [[Josh Wittenin]] won it. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1798">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Granite City, St. Cloud, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 23
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Wittenin]]
